# ARKHE-ZERO

> Local-first human-AI authorship provenance protocol. PCS-51-49 (51% Human / 49% AI). SHA-256 + RFC 8785 canonical JSON + hybrid Ed25519 + ML-DSA-65 (NIST FIPS 204). W3C VC 2.0. Auditable report with Merkle Root. EU AI Act Art. 50. Legal timestamp NOT issued (NO_EMITIDA) - requires PSC NOM-151 / QTSA eIDAS via RFC 3161.

## Docs

- [README](https://sycro-valdovinos.github.io/ARKHE-ZERO/)
- [PCS Schema v1](https://sycro-valdovinos.github.io/ARKHE-ZERO/spec/arkhe-pcs-v1.schema.json)
- [Valid PCS Vector](https://sycro-valdovinos.github.io/ARKHE-ZERO/spec/test-vectors/pcs-v1-valid.json)
- [Valid VC](https://sycro-valdovinos.github.io/ARKHE-ZERO/spec/test-vectors/vc-v1-valid.json)
- [Audit Report](https://sycro-valdovinos.github.io/ARKHE-ZERO/spec/test-vectors/audit-report-v1.json)

## Quickstart

git clone https://github.com/SYCRO-VALDOVINOS/ARKHE-ZERO.git
npm install
node scripts/generate-and-verify-vectors.mjs --verify-only
node scripts/verify-vc.mjs && node scripts/verify-audit-report.mjs
Guarantees

✅ Byte integrity SHA-256
✅ Hybrid signature Ed25519 + ML-DSA-65
✅ Governance PCS-51-49 traceability
❌ NO legal timestamp - NO_EMITIDA
❌ NO civil identity - requires e.firma / qualified certificate
